decisions.reason: Conferencing is a peripheral, low-investment add-on outside the announced software-defined infrastructure direction, so commitment is modest, but it costs little to keep within the broad portfolio.
The metro data centre network draws on owned fibre investment, is central to the announced data centre and cloud direction, and has publicly reported adoption, so commitment is strong.
Optical spectrum connectivity draws on sunk fibre investment, fits the high-bandwidth strategy, and was visibly showcased on its own page, which reinforces commitment.
The number ordering portal is a software platform that supports the real-time provisioning direction and costs little to maintain, so it stays.
Carrier pre-selection is a declining legacy telephony service with little strategic centrality, but its low running cost and regulatory ties make keeping it for now plausible.
Direct voice network connection builds on the established voice infrastructure and serves enterprise customers, so the firm persists with it.
